title: Beautiful Desk!
text: Beautiful Desk!. I ordered this desk for my 24 year old son. He just graduated from college and lives in our basement. He's gone into "grown up mode" over the last year or so and he suddenly cares about how things look in his space. He uses a standing desk for his computer, but he wanted a second desk to stand adjacent to it. Not only is this desk beautiful, but it's very high quality. It's very sturdy. It was easy to put together. My husband did assist with the job but the majority of the task was completed by my son. He is very pleased with the finished piece. It looks so much nicer than a basic desk!
